title: One task in both designs, run in the walkthrough.
caption: The task: {{fact:wt-task}}. One soroban-sim session per design ({{fact:wt-host}}), so `__check_auth` ran: the OpenZeppelin {{fact:oz-v080-tag}} account {{fact:wt-oz-account-build}} with oz-policy-builder's interpreter {{fact:opb-interpreter-wasm-short}} and OpenZeppelin's `spending_limit` {{fact:wt-oz-spending-limit-build}}, carrying the rule policy-synth synthesises from the task's declared Intent; and Perch {{fact:perch-pin-short}} with one grant. Signers: a delegated Stellar account on the OpenZeppelin side, as oz-policy-builder requires; an Ed25519 key checked by a verifier contract on the Perch side. Each refusal is an enforcing simulation that left the ledger unchanged. The steps are those of the [walkthrough page](https://bitswell-hq.github.io/stellar-registry__perch/oz-walkthrough/): page SHA-256 `{{fact:wt-page-sha256-short}}`, reference run `{{fact:wt-golden-sha256-short}}`.
